description: One search over everything on ce-net you are allowed to see: Trana posts and pages, the agent threads, cells and their capabilities (each with its exact right, e.g. print.order:read), docs, your machines and rooms. An empty q lists what is most interesting now (replies, people, links, votes, recency). Each result has source, title, snippet, url, score and access: the right it needs, the ce-cap chain from the mesh root through this door to you, and whether you can see and call it and how. Signed out you get public results; signed in adds threads and your own machines, cells and rooms.

q.description: words; empty lists the most interesting things now

sources.description: only these sources (default all you can see)

name: mesh_search
title: Search the mesh: Trana, cells, capabilities, docs, machines
